{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip;]'' early in my career, I'd tracked a thief, a Corellian named Thoxo, to the agriworld Yitabo.|Cradossk, ''Making a Killing''|<ref name="BH">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
'''Yitabo''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]]. [[Colonist/Legends|Settled]] by [[Borneck]]s, [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]], and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], it featured several settlements. Early in his career, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] tracked down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Thoxo]] on Yitabo. The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] known as "[[Gunman]]" was later [[Mission to Yitabo|captured]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&ndash;affiliated [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] who were seizing Wookiees near Yitabo at some point by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].

==Description==
Yitabo was a minor [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] located in the [[Yitabo system/Legends|Yitabo system]], a part of the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] in the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]]. It constituted a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']] connected Yitabo to the [[Chalacta system/Legends|Chalacta]] and [[Randon system/Legends|Randon systems]], while the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Durkteel Loop/Legends|Durkteel Loop]] linked it to the [[Durkteel system/Legends|Durkteel system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|I spent some time on a 'necklace' after Imperial slavers (who were seizing Wookiees near Yitabo) captured me.|Gunman, ''Gundark's Gear Datalog''|<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Cradossk-TFUCG.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The bounty hunter Cradossk once tracked down a target on Yitabo.]]
At one point early in the career of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]],<ref name="BH" /> he<ref name="CSWE Cradossk">{{CSWECite|I|151|Cradossk}}</ref> tracked down the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Thoxo]] to Yitabo. The [[Local day/Legends|day]] after his arrival on the agriworld, Cradossk actually met and talked with his target, though the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] was unaware of the fact due to Thoxo employing a disguise. Expecting the Corellian to be hiding in one of Yitabo's settlements, Cradossk disguised himself as a harmless [[Prospector/Legends|prospector]] and spent the following [[Standard week/Legends|week]] visiting the inhabited areas one by one and gaining the trust of local [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] and innkeepers, all the while looking out for Thoxo.<ref name="BH" />

Eventually, however, the Trandoshan realized his quarry was likely also hiding in plain sight and changed his approach. Changing into his bounty hunter's [[Clothing/Legends|attire]], Cradossk walked into the best inn of Yitabo's most upscale settlement and, firing his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] into the ceiling, yelled out Thoxo's name. The thief, who happened to be enjoying a drink at the establishment while disguised as a retired academic from<ref name="BH" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], then ran for the back door. At that point, Cradossk shot the [[Gender/Legends|man]] and subsequently hauled his body out of the inn. The bounty hunter went on to relate the incident in his<ref name="BH" /> [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]<ref name="18 BBY">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' dates the publication of ''[[Making a Killing]]'' to the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "17:7," which corresponds to [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> autobiography, ''[[Making a Killing]]''.<ref name="BH" />

[[Slaver/Legends|Enslavers]] associated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were capturing [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] near Yitabo<ref name="Gundark" /> at some point by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="8 ABY">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' dates [[Gunman]]'s comment on the [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] activity near Yitabo to the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "43:4:9," which corresponds to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> The enslavers eventually also captured the individual known as "[[Gunman]],"<ref name="Gundark" /> who was a member of the [[Churhee's Riflemen]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit<ref name="Cynabar">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> and who was [[Mission to Yitabo|performing reconnaissance]] on them for their unit, which intended to liberate the Wookiees. Gunman later noted the fact in a comment in the illegal database ''[[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]''.<ref name="Gundark" />

==Inhabitants==
Yitabo was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by members of the [[Borneck]], [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]], and Wookiee [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Because ''[Thoxo]'' wasn't anyone's idea of a rugged individual ''[&hellip;]'' I knew I'd find him hiding out in one of several settlements, probably at one of the better establishments.|Cradossk, ''Making a Killing''|<ref name="BH" />}}
Yitabo had several settlements that had establishments such as [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] and inns. All of the establishments that were of higher class were always relatively crowded.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yitabo was introduced in the [[1997]] sourcebook ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Gundark" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square Q-10.<ref name="TEA" />
